title: New Soda Rush to Cool Down Prices
story: FIZZ the soda company is sharing lots of their fizzy drinks with everyone to keep prices from going up. Kids will have plenty of soda without worry.
storyBig: FIZZ is coordinating a large release of its soda reserves to mitigate potential price increases and stabilize the market. This strategic action aims to maintain consumer confidence and ensure supply levels remain adequate.
think: What happens if there is too much of something for sale?
bull: More soda means everyone can enjoy their favorite flavors.
bear: Too much soda might mean lower profits for FIZZ.

rss: No more cereal at the end of the aisle? New rules in Scotland's supermarkets
title: Toy Brick Rules in Stores Change
story: BLOK toy bricks are now in different places at the store. They're not at the end of the aisle anymore. This means you might have to look harder to find them!
storyBig: BLOK toy bricks are being repositioned in stores due to new placement rules focusing on product display. This change could impact visibility and sales, requiring strategic adaptation by the company.
think: How does where something is sold in a store affect how much we buy it?
bull: Exploring the store might lead to discovering new toys!
bear: Finding your favorite toy might take longer.
